Content & Marketing Automation — publish consistently, without the manual work.

Kleza’s automation tools take the repetition out of content marketing. Blog publishing, social media scheduling, and editorial workflows run on intelligent systems.

Content gaps kill SEO momentum. Inconsistent posting kills audience trust.

Managing the editorial calendar, writing to SEO standards, formatting for each platform, and hitting publish on time is operationally expensive. Kleza’s automation layer removes that burden. Your brand publishes consistently, your team focuses on strategy.

What we automate

Two engines, one accountable team.

Sequential, hands-off content operations — each running on intelligent systems with human editorial sign-off at every step.

Blog Automation — Publishing on Autopilot

Kleza manages your entire blog pipeline — topic research, SEO brief creation, AI-assisted drafting, expert editorial review, formatting, image selection, metadata optimisation, scheduled publishing. Every post meets E-E-A-T standards.

Social Media Scheduling — Multi-Channel, Always On

Editorial Oversight

AI generates. Humans approve. Always.

Every piece of automated content passes through a Kleza editorial team before it goes live. We do not publish raw AI output. Our editors verify factual accuracy, brand voice consistency, HIPAA compliance for healthcare clients, and SEO quality before scheduling.
